Canadian PM Warns of US Interference Ahead of Alberta Independence Vote

Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney warned on Thursday that the United States is attempting to "break Canada" ahead of a vote on whether Alberta should begin the legal process toward separation from the country. Carney stated his expectation that nations, including the U.S., would refrain from interfering in the upcoming vote. Alberta, an oil-rich province, will decide if it wishes to remain a Canadian province or pursue independence.
